rationale: Verb taking ⲡⲧⲱⲁⲣⲡ ⲛ̄ⲙⲛⲧⲭⲁⲭⲉ ('the foremost of Enmity') as object; describes First Man's primordial action against the dark powers. Likely Lyc. reflex of ϥⲃⲟ 'weaken, abolish' or ⲫⲱⲃ 'destroy.' Confidence moderate.

proposed_english: the Established One of the Father
rationale: Substantival qualitative title applied to the First Man at line 3-4. Parallel to ⲡⲧⲱⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϩ as 'foundational standing.' The First Man as the Father's primordially-established cosmic being.
Title of the Beloved of the Lights at line 7. ⲛⲁⲃ̄ here is the adjectival 'great' (= ⲛⲟϭ) intensifying the Beloved title.
Title of the Living Spirit at line 9, paired with ⲡⲛⲁⲃ ⲛⲉⲕⲱⲧ 'Great Builder' (already in vocab). ⲛⲁⲃ̄ + Greek loan ἀρχιτέκτων.
ⲭⲱⲣⲉ̄ = ϫⲱⲱⲣⲉ 'strong, powerful' (Crum 783b). Substantival with article ⲡⲧ-. Title of the Living Spirit at line 13 as the cosmic strong-one who overpowered the darkness.
Compound ⲙⲁ- ('place of') + ⲙⲟⲩⲣ ('bind'). Cosmological term for the cosmos-as-prison built by the Great Builder for the dark powers.
Variant of ⲙⲣ̄ⲣⲉ 'bond, fettering' (Crum 181a). Used at line 16 of the cosmogonic act of fettering the powers of Enmity, paired with ⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲓⲥⲙⲟⲥ 'purification' as the dyadic function of the cosmos.
Standard Manichaean title of the Third Ambassador as ruler of the zodiacal Zone (= Greek ζώνη), the cosmic girdle through which Light is conveyed. ⲡⲣ̄ⲡⲟ here = 'the king' (Lyc for ⲡⲣ̄ⲣⲟ).
Verb at line 15 of Living Spirit's casting down the dark archons before establishing the cosmos. Likely cognate with ϩⲃⲟⲣⲃⲣ̄ 'overthrow.' Confidence moderate.

Day-ship = sun-ship, the solar cosmic vessel that ferries refined light upward. ⲫⲟⲟⲩⲉ = ϩⲟⲟⲩ 'day.' Standard Manichaean cosmological term, complementary to ⲡⲭⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲧⲟⲩⲱⲏ 'ship of the night' (moon-ship, in vocabulary).

proposed_english: the (one of the) Great One of the Spirit
rationale: Title of unclear referent at line 31. In the day-ship enumeration occupies position between the Third Ambassador and the Living Spirit. Possibly designates the Great Mind (Νοῦς) under a spirit-aspect, or a distinct emanation. Confidence low.
